content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: UIIC has announced 225 provisional vacancies for Administrative Officer (Scale I) across two disciplines. The category-wise breakup, including the 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), is given below. Note that these numbers are provisional and may vary as per the notification. A candidate can apply for either Generalists or Hindi Officers, but not both. Multiple registrations or appearances will lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates currently serving as Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in UIIC are not eligible to apply.

rows.no_of_posts: 200 (UR-68, OBC-62, EWS-22, SC-30, ST-18; PwBD horizontal: VI-2, HI-2, OC-4, MD/ID-3)
25 (UR-11, OBC-7, EWS-2, SC-4, ST-1; PwBD horizontal: VI-1)

content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the Nationality/Citizenship condition as on the date of application. A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the last four categories must hold an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification must have been obtained on or before 30.06.2026 from a recognised university or institute, approved by UGC/AICTE, through the 10+2+3 pattern or an equivalent system. Working knowledge of computers is mandatory for all candidates. Where only CGPA/OGPA/SGPA is awarded, candidates must produce a conversion certificate from the university; a fraction such as 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any discipline (including Engineering, Arts, Science, Commerce, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) from a recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)

Master’s Degree from a recognised university with Hindi and English in any of the specified combinations (as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination) at the degree level, with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)

content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 30.06.2026, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 30 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 30.06.1996 and not later than 30.06.2005 (both dates inclusive). Upper age relaxation is available as follows, subject to a cumulative cap of 45 years. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will draw basic pay in the scale of ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, along with other admissible allowances. In addition to emoluments, the Company provides Gratuity, LTS, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and National Pension System (NPS), with leased accommodation extended as per Company rules. Gross pay is approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres. Selected candidates will serve a probation period of one year (extendable at the Company’s discretion) and must pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India during probation. Candidates must also execute a guarantee bond to serve the Company for a minimum of five years, including the probation period; early resignation attracts liquidated damages plus a ₹35,000 onboarding and integration cost.

content_sections.heading: UIIC AO Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview. Tier I – Preliminary Examination (Qualifying, 100 marks, 60 minutes): English Language (30 questions/30 marks), Reasoning (35/35), Quantitative Aptitude (35/35). Tier II – Main Examination for Generalists: Objective Test of 250 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness with special reference to the Financial Sector, and Computer Knowledge – 200 questions, 150 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 30 marks (Letter Writing and Essay, 30 minutes). Tier II – Main Examination for Hindi Officers: Objective Test of 200 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Professional Knowledge of Hindi/English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge – 150 questions, 120 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 50 marks (English/Hindi essay, letter writing, and translation, 60 minutes). Interview: Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for interview, up to three times the vacancies in the respective category/discipline. For Generalists, the final merit list is prepared using Main Examination Objective Test marks and Interview marks in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary and Descriptive Test marks are not counted for merit. For Hindi Officers, the Main Examination (Objective + Descriptive) and Interview marks are considered in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary Examination marks are not counted for merit. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in the objective tests.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, colour, light background) Scanned signature in black ink (not in capital letters) Scanned left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink Handwritten declaration in English, in the candidate’s own handwriting, as per the prescribed format Valid Call Letter and original Photo Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter’s Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, or similar accepted ID) at the time of examination and interview Category/community, age, and educational qualification certificates, as applicable, at the time of interview Ration cards and Learner’s Driving Licences are not accepted as valid photo ID proof.

content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment section on the UIIC official website and click on “Apply Online”. Choose “Click here for New Registration” and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password. Log in and fill in the application form, using the “Save and Next” option to complete it in stages. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size. Preview the completed application form and verify all details carefully. Click “Complete Registration” only after confirming all details are correct, as no changes are permitted afterward. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the applicable application fee/service charges online. Click “Submit” and take a printout of the system-generated application form and payment receipt for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is the recruitment drive by United India Insurance Company Limited to fill 225 provisional vacancies for the post of Administrative Officer (Scale I) under the Generalists and Hindi Officers disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 225 provisional vacancies in total - 200 for Generalists and 25 for Hindi Officers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and payment of application fee is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Generalists need a Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any discipline with 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Hindi Officers need a Master’s Degree involving Hindi and English as specified in the notification, with 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years of age as on 30.06.2026, with age relaxation available for reserved categories as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹1,000/- plus GST for General/EWS/OBC applicants. SC/ST/PwBD/UIIC permanent employees pay no application fee but must pay ₹250/- plus GST as service charges.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the “Apply Online” link on the Recruitment section of the UIIC official website between 8th September 2026 and 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection consists of a Preliminary Examination (qualifying), a Main Examination (Objective and Descriptive Tests), and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UIIC Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The basic pay scale is ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, with a gross pay of approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres, along with other allowances and benefits.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for both Generalists and Hindi Officers posts?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for either the Generalists or the Hindi Officers discipline, but not both. Multiple registrations will result in cancellation of candidature.
